subject: URGENT: canopy rig bolt + comms cable damage — temporary shim and remote panelist plan
messages:
From: Venue AV Tech <tech@venueav.io>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Immediate: truss bolt shear and comms cable abrasion at demo row C3

Rishi / Marissa — on arrival we found a shear on one of the canopy truss M8 bolts (C3, corner A) and the adjacent Cat6 run has been pinched and scraped by the shifted bracket. Attached are photos and a quick vendor sketch.

Impact:
- 1 demo table (C3) has intermittent network to the switch — packets drop every ~10s when canopy shifts.
- Physical instability — canopy currently held by one remaining bolt plus safety strap.

Immediate recommendations from Venue AV:
1) Do a temporary shim (steel plate and 2x 10mm Grade 8 bolts) to re-seat the truss for the next 3–4 hours until a full replacement can be installed. See site_sketch_shim.pdf.
2) Move critical demo to portable Starlink/LTE router fallback and swap the damaged Cat6 to the spare patch on the floor box.
3) If a presenter is unable to be on-stage, we can bridge them via Zoom using the spare streamer laptop at Pod B.

We can do the shim and cable swap in ~25 minutes. Need explicit sign-off from your side to proceed.

[Attachment: img_truss_1.jpg (jpg)]
[Attachment: site_sketch_shim.pdf (pdf)]

— Marcus, Lead Tech, Venue AV
tech@venueav.io

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Venue AV Tech <tech@venueav.io>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, ethan_park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: truss bolt shear and comms cable abrasion at demo row C3

Marcus — thanks for the quick triage and photos. Please proceed with the temporary shim and the Cat6 patch swap now. We authorize the 25-minute fix window. Priorities: safety first (if the strap is needed, keep it), then network continuity for the CloudScale demo.

Marissa / Tessa — heads-up: CloudScale panelist Sarah Park is due on-stage at 09:00 PT for the 20-min live demo at Pod C3. Sarah is traveling light; if their laptop loses NIC connectivity we need to have an on-stand remote fallback.

Ethan — can you please stage the Starlink unit + LTE hotspot at Pod B and pre-provision a Zoom invite (hosted by redwood_events@redwood.ai) that we can hand to Sarah? If you can also pre-load the CloudScale demo page locally (chrome offline cache) that’s a bonus.

I’ll follow up with Sarah now to confirm willingness to present remotely if needed.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
[Attachment: vendor_report-081226.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sarah Park <sarah@cloudscale.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: truss bolt shear and comms cable abrasion at demo row C3

Hi Rishi — thanks for the ping and thanks to Marcus for the photos. I can absolutely go remote if the on-stage NIC is flaky — I’ll join via the Zoom invite and we can do the live screen share. If you can get me a wired patch as a backup that’s ideal, otherwise the Starlink fallback works.

If you anticipate >5 minutes of instability, pull me off-stage and we’ll do the session from the remote laptop — I’ll still participate in Q&A by audio.

See you in ~20.

— Sarah Park
Product Lead, CloudScale
sarah@cloudscale.com

From: ethan_park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: FIX COMPLETE: shim installed + patched, Starlink staged, Zoom ready

Quick update — shim is in place, replaced with 2x 10mm Grade 8 bolts and safety strap tensioned. Damaged Cat6 re-patched to floorbox port B12 (floor label C3-B). Verified link stability for 12 minutes with no drops. Starlink unit online and streaming laptop ready at Pod B (labeled "Streamer-B") with Zoom link pre-created: https://zoom.redwood.test/j/711-731-884.

Attachments: light config snapshot and post-fix photo.

If anyone wants extra redundancy I have a second LTE hotspot in the truck.

— Ethan Park
Field Tech, Redwood Events
ethan_park@redwood.ai
[Attachment: postfix-img.jpg (jpg)]
